reviews.text: Excellent service from reception to consultation and examinations.
Dr. Ricardo is a top-level professional, and his clinic is superbly equipped. Your friend deserves this kind of care.

I wanted to leave here a very special compliment for my friend and veterinarian, Dr. Renan.
Besides our friendship, there's something I admire very much: the incredible professional he is. You can see it in his care, his dedication, and the way he truly cares about each patient... it's not just technique, it's a real vocation.
I have enormous admiration for him, for his daily effort, and for always striving to do his best.
And I couldn't fail to thank him for taking such good care of Kakau... you know how much she is the love of my life. 💜 That makes all the difference to me.
Excellent veterinary clinic, dedicated professionals. I've been taking my cat there for a while now and I always leave very happy and relieved, knowing that she received excellent care and attention.
A wonderful clinic that I'm lucky to have nearby, to take care of my pet's health! I highly recommend it!
A super dedicated and professional team in caring for my puppy; thank you so much, I placed my complete trust in Dr. Ricardo and the entire clinic team for their excellence 🐶🙏 …

They are very professional and provide top-notch attention.
I can only thank Dr. Ricardo and his fantastic and caring team.
I was referred by veterinarian Dr. Raquel de Roseira, and it was great to have met Total Vet and its excellent team.

I would like to express my gratitude to the entire team at this clinic.
Dr. Ricardo, Dr. Renan, Gabi, and Clóvis.

Congratulations on your professionalism, competence, sensitivity, and respect for our furry children and the families of these beings we love so much.

Dr. Ricardo has always taken care of the family pets. Besides being an excellent professional, he's also a vet who understands and respects our bond with our animals. I recommend him without hesitation.

I recommend the Clinic with my eyes closed!! Dr. Ricardo and his team are wonderful!! I've been taking my two Yorkies to the clinic for years and they've always been very well received and cared for. My Fred had to undergo surgery to remove bladder stones. He's already an old man and needed all the care possible. We had no doubts about not having the surgery done at the hospital where we took him for an emergency consultation, and the approach was very discouraging and very commercial. We left the hospital devastated, thinking our dog was doomed, that was the feeling.

We scheduled with Dr. Ricardo, who reassured us and, with all his experience, brought us new horizons. On the day of the surgery, he and the team received us with all the care and affection for our puppy. He was discharged the same day and is here recovering very well. I am immensely grateful to the entire team, from reception to assistants and veterinarians. You make all the difference for us pet parents ❤️

What incredible professionals! My kitten was very ill, with cholangitis, a liver disease, almost dying. I took her to another clinic that "specialized" in felines, which was the worst thing I did. I ended up going back to TotalVet. The care …
I've always received excellent service! And Dr. Ricardo is so kind to my four-legged children. …
My dog ​​underwent orthopedic surgery, everything went well, and we received excellent care! I recommend them!

It's been a wonderful experience from start to finish! Lucas was so kind at reception, Clovis was always attentive in supporting the team, and the veterinary team, Dr. Ricardo and Dr. Renan, are beyond words to describe their competence, care, kindness, and professionalism. My 5 "children" are always grateful! I highly recommend them.
